parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products (
    product_name, provider_name, source_url, interest_rate,
    min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score,
    allowed_employment_status, min_age, max_age, special_criteria, updated_at
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.product_name }}',
    '{{ $json.provider_name }}',
    '{{ $json.source_url }}',
    {{ $json.interest_rate }},
    {{ $json.min_monthly_income }},
    {{ $json.min_credit_score }},
    {{ $json.max_credit_score }},
    '{{ $json.allowed_employment_status }}',
    {{ $json.min_age }},
    {{ $json.max_age }},
    '{{ $json.special_criteria }}',
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON CONFLICT (product_name) DO UPDATE SET
    interest_rate = EXCLUDED.interest_rate,
    min_monthly_income = EXCLUDED.min_monthly_income,
    min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
    allowed_employment_status = EXCLUDED.allowed_employment_status,
    min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age,
    max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
    special_criteria = EXCLUDED.special_criteria,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
